programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Impostora
programme.desc: Nimfa, an ugly street vender, meets jeremy, a talented plastice surgeon, in a car accident. To compensate for what happened, jeremy offers to help Nimfa by giving her new face through surgery. In her desire to change her life and escape her situation, she willingly undergoes complete facial reconstruction. She later discovers that her face is copied from Rosette, a wealthy and married woman who happens to be jeremy's lover. Rosette wants to escape her life with her husband and their kids. Forced to accept her circumstance, Nimfa becomes an imposer so Rosette and Jeremy can get away with their affair.

programme.title: Eglise Sainte Anne et les Piscines de Bethesda, Israel
programme.desc: Situee au debut de la Via Dolorosa, l’eglise Sainte-Anne est le site traditionnel de la maison des grands-parents maternels de Jesus, Anne et Joachim, et du lieu de naissance de la Vierge Marie. Nichee au cœur des rues animees et des ruelles du quartier musulman, l’eglise Sainte-Anne, la mieux conservee des eglises croisees de Jerusalem, se distingue par sa tranquillite. Elle se trouve dans une cour entouree d’arbres et d’arbustes.

programme.desc: Nimfa, an ugly street vender, meets jeremy, a talented plastice surgeon, in a car accident. She later discovers that her face is copied from Rosette, a wealthy and married woman who happens to be jeremy's lover. Rosette wants to escape her life with her husband and their kids. programme.title: FtWTF - Female to What The ...
programme.desc: After the transition is before the transition. This documentary begins where transbiographies often end. It tells the story of six young people who experience their trans identities in very different ways. programme.title: Amor Musical
programme.desc: Todo inicia cuando son transferidos a la escuela Jung San que recibe auspicio por parte de una fundación millonaria y poderosa. Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

programme.title: Abbaye benedictine d’Abu Gosh, Israel
programme.desc: Situe pres de Jerusalem, dans le village d’Abu Gosh, ce monastere benedictin est l’un des plus beaux vestiges des Croises et l’un des mieux conserves en Israel. Il s’agit d’une eglise gothique construite par les Hospitaliers en 1140. En 1889, le gouvernement français acquiert ce magnifique monastere et le site passe sous la supervision des peres benedictins français.

programme.title: 9 Lives
programme.desc: 9 LIVES portrays the fate of young people who decided at the age of 11, 12 or 13 to leave home and to live on the streets. Any of these young people could have lived nine lives by now and they have been battered, both mentally and physically. But despite this, they have an enormous ability to find their own strengths, gifts and talents.

programme.desc: La basilique de Jesus l’Adolescent, egalement appelee simplement eglise salesienne, est une eglise catholique a Nazareth en Israel, appartenant aux Salesiens de Don Bosco. Situee a cote de l’ecole des Salesiens, elle a ete construite entre 1906 et 1923 sur une colline appelee Mont du Debut, qui surplombe la ville, où, selon la tradition, Jesus a passe sa jeunesse. De la terrasse de l’eglise, la vue sur la vieille ville de Nazareth est exceptionnelle, divisee en quartiers orthodoxe, catholique romain et musulman.

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Polinesia Meridional
programme.desc: La loca geografía de la tierra de los hombres. El archipiélago de las Marquesas, formado por catorce islotes, es el más septentrional de los archipiélagos de Polinesia y, sin duda, el más aislado del mundo.

programme.title: Des Racines et des ailes - Passion Patrimoine
programme.sub-title: Sur les rives de la Garonne
programme.desc: Des Pyrenees espagnoles ou elle prend sa source, au vaste estuaire de la Gironde ou elle se jette, la Garonne parcourt plus de 600 kilometres a travers le Comminges, l'Agenais ou l'Entre-deux-Mers. Le fleuve evolue au cours de ce long voyage. L'apport de ses affluents, comme la Neste, l'Ariege, le Tarn et le Lot, modifie son visage. A bord d'un helicoptere, Didier Taillefer part en Espagne pour faire des photos aeriennes de l'une des principales sources du fleuve : le Trou du Toro. Ce site exceptionnel est situe au pied du massif de la Maladeta, ou la Garonne disparaît sous terre avant de reapparaître au Val d'Artan. Au coeur des Pyrenees, le fleuve donne naissance a un jardin de Cocagne : le Comminges. Dans le village de Huos, Remy Martin a amenage un verger-potager bio sur un ancien meandre.

programme.title: Amor Musical
programme.desc: Todo inicia cuando son transferidos a la escuela Jung San que recibe auspicio por parte de una fundación millonaria y poderosa. Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Polinesia de Gambier

programme.desc: Nimfa, an ugly street vender, meets jeremy, a talented plastice surgeon, in a car accident. To compensate for what happened, jeremy offers to help Nimfa by giving her new face through surgery. In her desire to change her life and escape her situation, she willingly undergoes complete facial reconstruction. She later discovers that her face is copied from Rosette, a wealthy and married woman who happens to be jeremy's lover. Rosette wants to escape her life with her husband and their kids. Forced to accept her circumstance, Nimfa becomes an imposer so Rosette and Jeremy can get away with their affair.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Opel Astra Electric im EAS

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - 8 Fakten zu Lackschutzfolien
programme.desc: Steinschläge, Lackkratzer und die Launen der Natur können das Aussehen und den Wert eines Autos erheblich beeinträchtigen. Doch es gibt eine Lösung, die nicht nur schützt, sondern auch stylisch ist: die Autofolierung. Alex erklärt welche Unterschiede es gibt und was es bei einer Folierung zu beachten gibt. Mit Drahtbürste, Steinschleuder und Gabelstapler macht Alex außerdem den Extrem-Haltbarkeitstest einer Lackschutzfolie.

Aber ist er nur billig oder auch wirklich sein Geld wert? Alexander Bloch macht den Test und zeigt auch die Unterschiede zum C3-Verbrenner und zum Konkurrenten Dacia Spring.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Cupra Tavascan VZ: Wieder der gleiche MEB-Brei?

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Renault Scenic E-Tech

programme.title: Brace For Impact - Indagine Ad Alta Quota
programme.desc: Tensione alle stelle in questo thriller che vede l'esperta di disastri aerei Sofia coinvolta in un'indagine per far chiarezza sulle reali cause di un tragico incidente in cui ha perso la vita il fratello. Il suo desiderio di giustizia la porterà a infrangere le regole del servizio di intelligence e a scoprire un complotto terroristico.

programme.title: Attacco Alieno Su Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nel Febbraio del 1942 un oggetto non identificato cade su Los Angeles. Settant'anni dopo gli alieni tornano per completare l'attacco attraverso una grande navicella spaziale atterrata sulla città. Le forze armate di Los Angeles rimangono sconvolte in quanto i loro missili non rispondono più ai comandi. Chi la spunterà?

programme.title: Frontier - Ai Confini Del Tempo
programme.desc: Il giovane e cinico Mikhail ha dedicato tutta la sua vita al lavoro sacrificando ogni tipo di relazione, fin quando un incontro con una donna e l'apertura di un misterioso portale gli fanno rimettere in discussione tutta la sua esistenza.

programme.title: 40 Days And Nights - Apocalisse Finale
programme.desc: Se un imponente spostamento tettonico causasse uno tsunami di proporzioni enormi, quale sarebbe l'unica soluzione? Recuperare l'insegnamento di Noè e della sua arca e costruire un'enorme nave capace di contenere solo cinquantamila persone, più il DNA di tutte le specie esistenti al mondo, cercando così di salvarle da una tempesta apocalittica.

programme.title: Super Cyclone
programme.desc: Inedito disaster movie firmato The Asylum. Un super ciclone minaccia l'intera costa orientale americana. Una solitaria meteorologa e un ingegnere petrolifero uniranno le loro forze per fermare la catastrofica minaccia naturale. Quella dei due scienziati sarà una corsa contro il tempo, nel tentativo disperato di arrestare la scia di distruzione che sta seminando dietro di sé.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, un virus di proporzioni epiche ha devastato il pianeta Terra, dove il numero degli infetti supera quello delle persone sane e l'unica speranza è trovare una cura per sconfiggere l'epidemia. La dottoressa Lauren Chase ha un obiettivo ben preciso: portare la sua squadra sul campo e salvare il maggior numero di sopravvissuti.

programme.title: Night Of The Wild
programme.desc: In una città apparentemente tranquilla, un meteorite produce un effetto pericoloso sui cani che si trasformano in assassini feroci. Con gli abitanti costretti a difendersi da quelli che un tempo erano gli amici più fedeli, la giovane Roslyn si ritrova a cercare un modo per sopravvivere. Cosa faresti al suo posto?

programme.title: Un Natale Di Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Action movie ambientato tra i ghiacci dell’Alaska con Brendan Fehr e Jodelle Ferland. Siamo alla Vigilia di Natale e l’idillio delle feste viene bruscamente interrotto quando i ghiacciai, sciogliendosi, iniziano a rilasciare grandi quantità di metano liquido che, se non fermato, rischia di far esplodere l'intero pianeta.

programme.title: Brace For Impact - Indagine Ad Alta Quota
programme.desc: Tensione alle stelle in questo thriller che vede l'esperta di disastri aerei Sofia coinvolta in un'indagine per far chiarezza sulle reali cause di un tragico incidente in cui ha perso la vita il fratello. programme.title: Absolon: Virus Mortale
programme.desc: Un virus ha infettato l'intera umanità e l'Absolon è un farmaco indispensabile per sopravvivere. Un agente di polizia inizia a indagare sull'omicidio di uno scienziato che stava lavorando a un antidoto contro il virus, arrivando a scoprire una cospirazione. Da quel momento diviene il bersaglio della società che monopolizza l'Absolon.

programme.title: Age Of Ice
programme.desc: Una serie di terremoti improvvisi e violenti scuote la placca tettonica, provocando tempeste e abbassando di colpo le temperature su tutto il pianeta. Nel tentativo di mettersi in salvo, la famiglia Jones, in vacanza in Egitto, dovrà resistere alle gelide temperature che segnano l'inizio di una nuova era glaciale in grado di ricoprire di neve la Sfinge, le Piramidi e il deserto del Sahara.

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: Una squadra di terroristi dirotta un aereo di linea statunitense, lo Starquest, il più avanzato e grande aereo passeggeri del mondo. Quando Harriet Franklin, Presidente degli Stati Uniti, apprende che sull'aereo viaggia anche suo fratello, è chiamata a scegliere tra la sua famiglia e la sicurezza delle persone nelle città sottostanti, qualora il velivolo fosse costretto a schiantarsi al suolo.

programme.title: End Of The World
programme.desc: Mentre una massa di tempeste solari provoca tsunami, vulcani e inondazioni, una famiglia tenta di fuggire dalla città verso la relativa salvezza in un gruppo di grotte ad alta quota a diverse miglia di distanza dall'occhio del ciclone.

programme.desc: Anna Fritz, una famosa y bella actriz, ha fallecido recientemente. Tres jóvenes se cuelan en la morgue para verla desnuda, fascinados por su belleza.

programme.title: 30 noches con mi ex
programme.desc: El Turbo, luego de años de separado de La Loba, acepta por pedido de la hija que tienen en común, convivir durante treinta días con su exmujer, quien viene de una larga internación psiquiátrica.

programme.title: La noche del demonio
programme.desc: Una familia busca evitar que los espíritus malignos atrapen a su hijo que cayó en estado de coma.

programme.title: Free Guy: Tomando el control
programme.desc: Un empleado de banco descubre que en realidad es un personaje dentro de un videojuego.

programme.title: El Renacido
programme.desc: En una expedición de comercio de pieles en la década de 1820, un hombre lucha por sobrevivir después de ser atacado por un oso y abandonado por su propio equipo de caza.

programme.title: Ant-Man
programme.desc: El ladrón de gatos Scott Lang, debe adherirse a su héroe interior y ayudar a su mentor, el Dr. Hank Pym, a planear y llevar a cabo un atraco que salvará al mundo.

programme.title: Buenos Vecinos
programme.desc: Una pareja con un recién nacido tiene de vecinos a una pesadilla de fraternidad universitaria. Harán todo lo posible para echarlos de allí.

programme.title: Monster High
programme.desc: En el pueblo de New Salem, los hijos adolescentes de los monstruos famosos asisten a una escuela para monstruos llamada Monster High.

programme.title: Comando Especial
programme.desc: Dos policías de bajo rendimiento tienen la misión de infiltrarse en un instituto como estudiantes y derrocar una trama para el tráfico de drogas sintéticas.

programme.title: Cuando las luces se apagan
programme.desc: Rebecca salió de casa pensando que dejaría atrás sus miedos de la infancia, ya que nunca supo qué era real y qué no cuando se apagaban las luces. Ahora, su hermano Martin está viviendo los mismos eventos que ya pusieron a prueba la cordura de Rebecca.

programme.title: El Extranjero
programme.desc: La historia de un humilde hombre de negocios, Quan (Jackie Chan), cuyo pasado erupciona en una venganza desenfrenada después de que su hija muera en un atentado terrorista motivado por aspectos políticos. En su búsqueda de los terroristas, Quan se ve atrapado en un juego del gato y el ratón con un político irlandés que colabora con el gobierno británico (Pierce Brosnan), cuyo pasado podría tener algo que ver con los asesinos.

programme.title: The Forgiven
programme.desc: Tiene lugar durante un fin de semana en las montañas del Alto Atlas de Marruecos y explora las repercusiones de un accidente aleatorio en la vida de los musulmanes locales y los visitantes occidentales de una fiesta en una gran villa.

programme.title: Des Femmes et des Bêtes
programme.sub-title: Des Femmes et des Bêtes Ep. 1

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: RAZOR: AI Drug Discovery & Biodiversity Protection
programme.desc: In part-1 of the the show, developing a single drug can take decades and billions of dollars, but AI is transforming the process. RAZOR's Emma Keeling meets Dr. Alex Zhavoronkov, CEO of Insilico Medicine, a biotech firm using AI to automate drug discovery—from identifying targets to designing molecules and accelerating clinical trials. The company has 31 drug candidates, including the first AI-designed drug to enter human trials. In part-2, climate change threatens Europe's largest reed belt and its rare wildlife at Lake Neusiedl in Austria. Zhang Nini joins researchers from Rainforest Connection, the University of Vienna, Huawei Austria, and the National Park for a two-year AI-powered acoustic monitoring project. Their goal: protect birds, bats, and amphibians through better biodiversity conservation planning.

programme.title: RAZOR: Rainforests Restoration
programme.desc: Some of the rarest habitats on Earth exist right here in Britain—temperate rainforests draped in ancient moss and home to species found nowhere else. Yet only fragments remain, scattered along the Atlantic fringe of the British Isles. RAZOR’s Russell Beard meets the scientists pioneering new methods to restore these vanishing ecosystems, combining cutting-edge research with traditional land management to bring Britain’s forgotten forests back to life. The team visits the Wildlife Trust of South and West Wales, which is working to restore 120 acres at Trellwyn Fach in Pembrokeshire’s Gwaun Valley. Backed by ￡38 million in funding, the project aims to create 1,755 hectares of new rainforest by 2050.

programme.title: Live: Beyond the buzz: What do young Americans really think about China-US relations?
programme.desc: What happens when young Americans experience China beyond the headlines? Join CGTN for a candid conversation with US creators and students living in China as they share firsthand perspectives on daily life, consumer trends, innovation, and how these experiences are reshaping their understanding of China's economic dynamism and China-US connections.

programme.title: Discovering Guizhou: The Guitar Fanatic
programme.desc: In Zheng'an County, Guizhou province, a thriving guitar manufacturing industry has emerged, supplying major international brands and providing thousands of jobs. In this episode, we meet the guitar-makers, the musicians, and the dreamers who've transformed an entire region by turning strings into stories.

programme.title: Vive La Tech: Approaching the limits of temperature measurement
programme.desc: In this episode of CGTN's special program "Vive La Tech," we dive into the "frozen world". In low-temperature metrology, scientists created the world's most precise temperature measuring device, from 5 to 24.5 kelvin, providing a source for all thermometers around the world. Join CGTN reporter Yang Zhao to explore how such an innovative partnership can open new doors for fundamental science.

programme.title: Vive la Tech: Climate change is changing French wine
programme.desc: CGTN's new special program "Vive La Tech" focuses on some of the coolest science collaborations between China and France. In this episode, we shift our attention to climate change and the grape at risk. Follow our reporter Yang Zhao into the vineyards.

programme.title: What DeepSeek V4 signals for the global AI race beyond computing
programme.desc: China's DeepSeek AI startup has unveiled its latest model, reportedly at just a fraction of the cost of comparable U.S. systems. Could that price edge help it win over users? Reports say the launch was delayed to align with Chinese-made chips, marking a shift toward domestic hardware. Is that trade-off worth it? And after a stark warning from Nvidia's CEO and fresh pressure from Washington, what does this moment mean for DeepSeek's global presence? Host TU Yun joins Thorsten Jelinek, a research fellow at the Hertie School's Center for Digital Governance, Berlin, Germany. He is currently a visiting professor at the Aerospace Information Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; Dr. Zhou Mi, a senior research fellow at the Chinese Academy of International Trade and Economic Cooperation; and Josef Mahoney, a professor of politics and international relations at the East China Normal University to break down what DeepSeek V4 signals for the AI race beyond compute.

programme.title: Inside the token surge: Where does the money flow in AI?
programme.desc: From "OpenClaw" to open-source AI agents, token demand is exploding. But where's the real money? CGTN x top AI experts on the AI gold rush, key players, and the inside track on where the money flows. Listen now.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Highland industries, high-quality future
programme.desc: From smart ranching to vegetable greenhouses, from cold-chain logistics to cross-border trade… We take a look at Xizang's industrial transformation and see how the plateau is leaping into a new era of development.

programme.title: Global business voices on China-US trade relations
programme.desc: China-US relations draws global attention, the global business community is closely watching what US President Donald Trump's visit to China means for trade, investment and market confidence. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN’s Lincoln Humphries sits down with Fred Teng, president of the AmericaChina Public Affairs Institute, Chris Torrens, chairman of the British Chamber of Commerce in China, and Oliver Oehms, executive director and board member of the German Chamber of Commerce in China – North China; exploring investment sentiment, business trends and why China-US cooperation still matters in an uncertain global economy.

programme.title: Proof over Promise: Insights on Real-World AI Adoption
programme.desc: At a moment when artificial intelligence is moving beyond hype into measurable impact, the key question is no longer what AI can do—but how it delivers at scale. From manufacturing floors to energy systems, the race is on to turn promise into proof. As home to one of the fastest-moving AI deployment environments, how is China translating policy into large-scale industrial application? Join BizTalk as we team up with the World Economic Forum, bringing together leaders from WEF, CATL, and Schneider Electric to explore how AI is being driven by real business needs, and how it’s redefining the future of intelligent manufacturing.

programme.title: CHINA EXPANDS ZERO-TARIFF TO 53 AFRICAN NATIONS
programme.desc: Starting May 1st, China will expand preferential duty-free treatment for all imports from 53 African countries. CGTN host Vivienne Nunis talks to Namibian Minister of International Relations and Trade Selma Ashipala-Musavyi, Professor from Tsinghua University Tang Xiaoyang and Political Analyst Adriel Kasonta from the UK, to find out how the move will boost two-way trade between China and Africa, strengthen Africa's competitiveness in global trade and boost integrity within the continent.

programme.title: Global Business-American Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.1
programme.desc: When Zhejiang's winding river meets the sea it encounters a coastal region studded with islands. On this journey we survey a land of bays, bridges and harbors that is a glorious archipelago of memory, history and culture...

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you’ll encounter one of China’s most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What’s life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we’re embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: China Bound: Chongqing
programme.desc: Join us in southwest China's Chongqing, one of the world's biggest cities. From futuristic skylines and cyberpunk streets, to fire-breathing opera, spicy hotpot and kungfu tea, we're diving deep into this megacity the size of Austria.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.1
programme.desc: When Zhejiang's winding river meets the sea it encounters a coastal region studded with islands. On this journey we survey a land of bays, bridges and harbors that is a glorious archipelago of memory, history and culture...

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you’ll encounter one of China’s most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What’s life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we’re embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game "Sifu" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to "eat porridge at night"

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.2
programme.desc: Sichuan's western mountains are a shield safeguarding a true national treasure: the Chengdu Plain, China's very own land of plenty. Join us as we dive from high plateaus into deep gorges, scale snow peaks, and follow rivers in pursuit of an engineering marvel bequeathed by the ancients...

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.

programme.title: Zapatillas Ferragamo
programme.desc: Rebeca es la hija de un poderoso mafioso, quien debe tomar el control del imperio de su padre después de que él es encarcelado.

programme.title: Krampack
programme.desc: Una historia española sobre la mayoría de edad que se centra en las travesuras de dos jóvenes de 17 años, que tienen una lujosa casa en la playa casi para ellos solos un verano. Este es un verano de despertares sexuales.

programme.title: Amalia
programme.desc: Una mujer se obsesiona con la amante de su ex amante.

programme.title: El Turno Nocturno
programme.desc: Diego es un joven al cual su vida se ha quedado estancada en la misma rutina de siempre, trabajando en una estación de GNC. Cuando le toca la tarea de atender su primer turno nocturno, una cantidad de situaciones y personajes aparecen de la oscuridad para abrirle los ojos y darse cuenta de que no pertenece ahí.

programme.title: Aurelia la Texana
programme.desc: Aurelia busca venganza por la muerte de su madre.

programme.title: Puerta de Hierro, El Exilio de Perón
programme.desc: La casa del presidente exiliado, lejos de Buenos Aires, se vuelve centro de resistencia popular.

programme.title: Guatemala 1982
programme.desc: Adrián Morales va a Jutiapa para recolectar las tarjetas de identificación de armas, entregadas por un amigo de su padre, el Coronel Fuentes. Equivocadamente identificado como miembro de la guerrilla, es retenido cautivo en la ciudad.

programme.title: Sin verguenza
programme.desc: A Isabel se le presenta un guion de pelicula. Al leerlo, descubre que es el romance que vivio ella misma 21 años antes con el director Mario Fabra, el autor del guion.

programme.title: Puerta de Hierro, El Exilio de Perón
programme.desc: La casa del presidente exiliado, lejos de Buenos Aires, se vuelve centro de resistencia popular.

programme.title: El Túnel de los Huesos
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, mientras intentan una espectacular fuga, siete prisioneros hacen un extraño y aterrador descubrimiento en el túnel hacia su libertad.

programme.title: El valle Oscuro
programme.desc: Un jinete solitario llega a un remoto y aislado pueblo de los Alpes austríacos, donde, a pesar de no ser bienvenido, se le permite quedarse antes del duro invierno. Se presenta como un fotógrafo de Estados Unidos, pero nadie sospecha que el misterioso extranjero ha llegado al valle para cumplir una venganza. La violencia flota en el aire en este pueblo de leñadores, dominado por un viejo clan familiar que impone sus leyes, aterrorizando a sus habitantes.

programme.title: County Line
programme.desc: Cuando el mejor amigo del ex sheriff Alden Rockwell es tiroteado, éste se ofrece como investigador privado para averiguar la verdad tras el tiroteo y descubre una conspiración criminal entre dos condados.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: Un operativo de Black Ops es enviado a una remota estación de la CIA para proteger a un operador de código. Pronto se encuentran en una situación a vida o muerte, intentando desmantelar una trama letal antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Gun shy
programme.desc: La historia sigue a Turk Henry (Antonio Banderas), una superestrella del rock con discos de platino, casado con una supermodelo (Olga Kurylenko) y más rico de lo que jamás soñó. Durante unas vacaciones, su esposa es misteriosamente secuestrada por un grupo de piratas renegados sin barco. Con poca ayuda de las autoridades locales, Turk se ve obligado a embarcarse en una misión para rescatarla. Con habilidades más aptas para tocar el bajo, ligar y salir de fiesta, tendrá que enfrentarse a peligrosas selvas y a despiadados bandidos en esta divertida y trepidante aventura llena de acción.

programme.title: El Hombre del Presidente
programme.desc: Un agente secreto altamente clasificado del presidente de Estados Unidos debe encontrar un intrépido sustituto que se haga cargo de sus peligrosísimas misiones militares.

programme.title: La Noche nunca Duerme
programme.desc: En el transcurso de una sola noche, el sargento de Crímenes Callejeros de Nueva York Thomas Cavanaugh (Dan Brennan) y sus compañeros Rourke (Stephanie Finochio) y Jablonsky (Robert Clohessy) persiguen a los asesinos de uno de los miembros de su grupo de trabajo, buscando información entre los sórdidos habitantes de un barrio infestado de delincuencia.

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Situé au Viêt Nam en avril 1968, trois mois après l'offensive du Têt et un mois après l'assassinat de Martin Luther King Jr, Point Man raconte l'histoire d'une équipe de pompiers de l'armée américaine fracturée par les tensions raciales, les crises morales et les pressions écrasantes du combat dans une guerre que personne ne veut mener. Andre « Casper » Allen, un idéologue brutal, est en désaccord avec Silas Meeks, le mitrailleur de l'escouade, en raison de ses idées radicales. Lorsque leur mission de recherche et de destruction dans le delta du Mékong tourne mal, les deux hommes se retrouvent opposés l'un à l'autre et à leur chef de section récalcitrant, le lieutenant Sutter. Les hommes de pointe meurent comme des mouches dans la brousse, et à mesure que les loyautés se dissolvent, chaque pas en avant a un prix.

programme.title: Vacaciones en el infierno
programme.desc: Un delincuente profesional atrapado por las autoridades mexicanas es internado en una dura prisión donde aprende a sobrevivir con la ayuda de un niño.

programme.title: El Cobrador 2
programme.desc: Two debt collectors are plunged into an extremely dangerous situation, pursuing various criminals while evading a vengeful enemy.

programme.title: Glaciación 2012
programme.desc: Una erupción volcánica en Islandia envía un glaciar hacia Norteamérica, provocando la congelación de todo lo que encuentra a su paso. Un padre de familia lucha por escapar del ataque de la era glacial que se avecina.

programme.title: El joven detective Dee
programme.desc: China, año 665 d.C. La dinastía Tang está siendo amenazada por el reino coreano de Buyeo. Por ello, se envían barcos de guerra como advertencia. Sin embargo, la flota queda reducida a cenizas antes de llegar a su destino, supuestamente por el ataque del Dragón del Mar. La emperatriz ordena resolver el misterio de la desaparición de la flota de forma inmediata. El joven Dee llega ese mismo día para ocupar un puesto en el Departamento de Justicia.

programme.title: Buffalo soldiers
programme.desc: 1989. El muro de Berlín está a punto de caer y el planeta va a convertirse en un lugar seguro según un nuevo orden mundial. El especialista Ray Elwood, en la Base del ejército norteamericano, está a punto de comprobar cómo su particular guerra fría se pone al rojo vivo. Elwood, bastante granuja, atiendo su trabajo como secretario del oficial superior. Cuando llega a la base un nuevo Sargento Primero, éste se dedicará a limpiarla de arriba abajo. Para mayor complicación, Elwood le echa el ojo a la hija del Sargento.

programme.title: Truth or Die
programme.desc: Un millonario ha sido brutalmente asesinado en su casa y se han llevado un valioso maletín de la caja de seguridad. Cuando el guardaespaldas del millonario regresa a la escena del crimen, se encuentra con tres testigos-sospechosos: el hijo del millonario, una joven aparentemente dulce y un mago bohemio. Los tres relatan las escenas del asesinato desde puntos de vista opuestos, cada uno con una versión diferente de quién cometió el crimen.

programme.title: Cut off (esp)
programme.desc: El policía forense Paul Herzfeld encuentra dentro de la cabeza de un cuerpo mutilado una cápsula que contiene un número de teléfono y el nombre de su hija.

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: Maximum Impact
programme.desc: Une équipe d'agents russes et américains s'assemblent pour sauver la petite-fille du Secrétaire de la Défense américain. Kidnappée par un syndicat du crime asiatique, sa disparition pourrait déclencher une crise financière mondiale.

programme.title: Karyn l'Obstinée
programme.desc: Une inspectrice de la criminelle est obligée de travailler avec son ex-fiancé pour enquêter sur un meurtre qui porte toutes les marques d'un infâme tueur en série.

programme.title: Le Jour de La Colère
programme.desc: Espagne, au XVIe siècle pendant l'Inquisition. Une série de meurtres particuliers secoue le pays. Le shérif Ruy de Mendoza mène l'enquête...

programme.title: Swim
programme.desc: Une famille est prise au piège alors que la maison de vacances qu'elle loue est inondée par la pluie et qu'un requin agressif a réussi à s'y introduire.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond est un blanchisseur d'argent à New York qui se réveille sans aucun souvenir, avec des millions de dollars en espèces volées et de la drogue. Il doit rapidement parcourir les rues à la recherche de réponses tout en essayant d'échapper à une équipe de policiers violents et corrompus.

programme.title: L'Attaque des Drones
programme.desc: L'invasion a eu lieu, les vaisseaux absorbant les ressources de la Terre, tandis que des drones patrouillent les villes en ruines pour éliminer la moindre menace. Un réseau de survivants s'organisent pour mettre à terre le vaisseau-mère.

programme.title: Hercules Reborn
programme.desc: La fiancée d'un jeune homme est kidnappée par un roi impitoyable, Hercule est appelé à l'aide. En exil depuis des années, le guerrier retrouve l'espoir à travers l'amour du garçon pour sa bien-aimée. Ensemble, ils vont combattre le tyran.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: La station spatiale internationale est désormais une prison - le site noir par excellence. Personne n'en sort. Et personne ne sait qu'elle est là. Mais lorsque les terroristes emprisonnés prennent le contrôle de la station et la transforment en un missile visant Moscou, seuls un pilote de navette et un médecin débutant peuvent les arrêter. Leur tâche est compliquée par un agent de la CIA véreux (Scott Adkins) qui a ses propres plans pour la station et les terroristes qui s'y trouvent.

programme.title: Midnight Heat
programme.desc: Un banquier amnésique se cache de la police lorsqu'il est accusé du meurtre de sa femme.

programme.title: A Good Man
programme.desc: Un ancien assassin sort de son réseau habituel pour une mission de type guérilla.

programme.title: Les Nazis Au Centre De La Terre
programme.desc: Des Nazis ont réussi à se cacher au centre de la Terre et y préparent le retour en force du IIIe Reich. Des chercheurs scientifiques, en Antarctique, sont ainsi kidnappés par des soldats masqués. Leur but? Préparer une armée constituée de corps revenus à la vie...

programme.title: L'Apocalypse de Stonehenge
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un groupe d'archéologues déterre un squelette humain près du monument historique de STONEHENGE, une ancienne machine cachée sous la roche est découverte. Ne sachant pas de quoi il s'agit, les ouvriers déclenchent accidentellement le mécanisme et déclenchent une série d'événements qui pourraient bien mettre fin au monde tel que nous le connaissons.

programme.title: Dernières Heures de la Terre
programme.desc: Après que de la matière dense provenant d’un trou blanc implosé ait frappé la Terre, la rotation de la planète est dévastée. Un groupe d’agents gouvernementaux doit retrouver un réseau de satellites perdu, seul espoir de survie pour l’humanité.

programme.title: Les Rebelles de PT-218
programme.desc: En pleine Seconde Guerre mondiale, l'océan Atlantique devient un champ de bataille mortel lorsqu'un torpilleur américain se bat contre le bombardement constant des forces allemandes

programme.title: La Vengeza de los cheyennes
programme.desc: Cuando Charlotte Sutter es secuestrada por los apaches, su hermano Sam, ayudado por un viejo prospector borracho, va en su busca.

programme.title: I Pirati Della Malesia
programme.desc: Tra esotiche terre d’Oriente, il leggendario Sandokan guida i suoi uomini contro il dominio coloniale, tra battaglie navali e avventure senza sosta. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi, con Steve Reeves.

programme.title: Randy Cabalga Alone
programme.desc: Encarcelado por unos asesinatos que no cometió, Randy escapa sólo para tropezar con la guarida de los verdaderos asesinos.

programme.title: Il Terrore Dei Mari
programme.desc: Tra arrembaggi e inseguimenti nei mari tropicali, un audace pirata sfida flotte nemiche e tradimenti per conquistare libertà e tesori. Un’avventura ricca di azione e colpi di scena, firmata da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: West of the divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden se hace pasar por un hombre buscado y se une a la banda de Gentry sólo para enterarse más tarde de que Gentry fue quien mató a su padre. Salva de Gentry el rancho del padre de Virginia Winters y también rescata a su hermano Spud, perdido hace mucho tiempo.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Jeb Drummond es un pastor de ovejas asesino que ha tomado a Adam como rehén para intentar obligar a Ben a cederle una gran parte de las tierras de Ponderosa.

programme.title: La Spada E La Croce
programme.desc: Con Yvonne De Carlo, passioni e destino si intrecciano nella Roma attraversata da grandi cambiamenti.

programme.title: Yo soy la revolución
programme.desc: La banda del Chuco roba armas de un tren para venderlas a los revolucionarios del General. Un pasajero americano los ayuda en el asalto y se une a ellos contra el ejército mexicano. Entre Chuco y el gringo se establece una extraña amistad.

programme.title: Messalina
programme.desc: Con Belinda Lee, Messalina intreccia seduzione e potere nella Roma imperiale tra passioni e congiure.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP19 - Los asesinos a sueldo
programme.desc: Hoss y Little Joe son confundidos con sanguinarios asesinos a sueldo en un pequeño pueblo de Texas dominado por dos familias enemistadas.

programme.title: UN AMENAZA EN LA SOMBRA
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su madre, un cazarrecompensas de armas tomar encuentra al padre que nunca conoció, que está librando una guerra en la pradera contra un poderoso barón de la tierra.

programme.title: Erode Il Grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: Una pistola para cien cruces
programme.desc: Un irlandés es asesinado en el salvaje Oeste. Su hijo Jimmy sale en busca de los asesinos de su padre, pero pronto cae en una emboscada de dos salteadores de caminos y es asesinado también. Django (o Sartana, según la versión de la película) lo encuentra y lee la carta que Jimmy había recibido de su hermana Jessica Dublin contándole el asesinato de su padre.

programme.title: Piena Di Grazia
programme.desc: Dopo la resurrezione, Maria guida i discepoli tra dubbi e speranza custodendo il messaggio destinato a cambiare il mondo.

programme.title: Eminence Hills
programme.desc: Un rastro de venganza conduce a un notorio asesino y a un agente de la ley a un pueblo de fanáticos. Correrá la sangre.

programme.title: Nel Segno Di Roma
programme.desc: Con Anita Ekberg e diretto anche dal grande Michelangelo Antonioni.Nell’antica Roma, guerre, alleanze e passioni si intrecciano mentre un impero lotta per imporre il proprio destino.

programme.title: I Dieci Gladiatori
programme.desc: Dieci guerrieri vengono scelti per una missione decisiva tra duelli, intrighi e battaglie che possono cambiare il destino di Roma.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: Durante el fragor de la batalla en plena Guerra Civil, nace un potro seductoramente inocente de la querida yegua del soldado Jim Rabb. Rechazando la orden de matarlo para que no se convierta en un estorbo, Rabb se queda con el potro como consuelo en estos tiempos desesperados, un símbolo de esperanza que lleva a los hombres del Primer Arma de Caballería a un viaje de autodescubrimiento y nueva hermandad.

programme.title: Tiroteo en Río Bravo
programme.desc: Un misterioso pistolero ruso ayuda a un jefe de policía y a un comisario en un enfrentamiento con una sanguinaria banda de forajidos conocida como Los Sabuesos del Infierno, que han invadido su pequeño pueblo del este de Texas.

programme.title: Maciste All'inferno
programme.desc: Tra inferi, magie oscure e creature demoniache, Maciste affronta una sfida estrema per salvare innocenti dal male.

programme.title: Tu Cabeza vale mas de 1000 dolares
programme.desc: Para cumplir el último deseo de su madre, un cazarrecompensas intenta encontrar a su hermanastro, un desertor confederado convertido en delincuente, y entregarlo a la ley.

programme.title: Il Gladiatore Di Roma
programme.desc: Nell’arena e nei palazzi del potere, un gladiatore combatte tra intrighi e duelli per cambiare il proprio destino.

programme.title: Black Killer
programme.desc: En Tombstone, un nuevo sheriff jura limpiar la ciudad de forajidos como los hermanos O'Hara y cuenta con la ayuda de un extraño abogado que siempre lleva consigo dos grandes libros de derecho.

programme.title: I Sette Gladiatori
programme.desc: Un grande film d'avventura con scontri fino all'ultimo sangue. Il gladiatore Dario, libero grazie alle sue vittorie, torna in patria. Qui, al posto del padre che vi governava, trova un tiranno usurpatore che l'ha ucciso. Con l'aiuto di sei validi combattenti, cercherà di rimettere tutto al proprio posto.

programme.title: El Hombre el orgullo y la venganza
programme.desc: Un incondicional soldado español recurre a la delincuencia para demostrar su amor por una misteriosa y promiscua gitana.

programme.title: Davide E Golia
programme.desc: Con Orson Welles, Davide affronta Golia nella sfida che segna il destino di Israele

programme.title: Los Profesionales del oro
programme.desc: Cuatro hombres se embarcan en una misión para desenterrar una fortuna en oro de una mina.

programme.title: Erode Il Grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: Ercole Contro Roma
programme.desc: Tra rivolte, tradimenti e scontri spettacolari, Ercole affronta Roma per difendere il suo popolo e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: Los McMasters
programme.desc: Cuando un veterano negro de la Guerra Civil se convierte en copropietario del rancho sureño de los McMasters, los indignados veteranos confederados locales vienen a por él y su esposa india.

programme.title: Erik Il Vichingo
programme.desc: Tra terre nordiche e battaglie epiche, il guerriero Erik affronta nemici e tradimenti in una lotta per onore e potere, tra duelli e conquiste. Diretto da Mario Caiano con Giuliano Gemma.

programme.title: Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Un veterano confederado que vive en el Norte yanqui lucha contra el mutismo inducido por el shock de su hijo y el odio de los norteños.

programme.title: Django Kill... Tire encore si tu peux
programme.desc: Diverses factions, dont un bandit métis, une bande de cow-boys homosexuels et un prêtre, se disputent l'or volé dans une ville surréaliste.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: Killer Kid
programme.desc: L'impitoyable et cruel capitaine Ramirez traque et tue les révolutionnaires dans sa quête du Saint, le chef vertueux de l'insurrection mexicaine contre les Fédéraux.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Les préjugés fusent de part et d'autre lorsque Ben donne à un Indien nommé Matsou et à sa femme une partie de ses terres, après avoir sauvé la vie de Ben d'un Indien renégat qui avait failli le tuer sur le Ponderosa.

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: Pour Django les salauds ont un prix
programme.desc: La fiancée de Django a été enlevée. Il doit donc la sauver, mais ce n'est pas une mince affaire. Le problème, c'est que les ravisseurs sont les frères Cortez et leur bande. Ils ont braqué une banque et se sont réfugiés dans une grotte. Django se lance à leur poursuite avec l'aide d'un Américain et de Fulton. Fulton est un agent chargé de ramener l'or à la banque.

programme.title: Les colts de la violence
programme.desc: Il y a douze ans, Sartana a fait accuser son frère Johnny de meurtre et lui a volé sa petite amie. Devenu le chef incontesté de la ville et choyé par sa mère possessive, Sartana semble en sécurité - jusqu'à ce que, sa peine purgée, Johnny revienne en ville.

programme.title: Route mystérieuse
programme.desc: Un détective aborigène retourne dans l'Outback australien pour enquêter sur le meurtre d'une jeune fille.

programme.title: Son nom est Pote
programme.desc: Après que Pot et son frère Ray aient dévalisé une banque, Pot est arrêté mais parvient à s'échapper. Il rencontre un bandit nommé Steve et ils complotent pour cambrioler une autre banque locale. Avec l'aide d'un croque-mort qui creuse ses tombes à la dynamite, ils réussissent à vider le coffre-fort. Cependant, ce que Pot ne sait pas, c'est que Steve coopère avec Lobo, un bandit mexicain, qui capture Ray afin de s'approprier tout l'argent.

programme.title: Ta tombe est prête Sartana !
programme.desc: Deux cow-boys se font voler leur or dans les montagnes rocheuses et décident de se défendre en affrontant les bandits.

programme.title: Route mystérieuse
programme.desc: Un détective aborigène retourne dans l'Outback australien pour enquêter sur le meurtre d'une jeune fille.

programme.title: Je vais... je tire... et je reviens
programme.desc: Un gang dérobe une cargaison d'or dans un train. Un soi-disant chasseur de primes est envoyé à la recherche des voleurs et décide de les laisser le conduire jusqu'à l'or.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississipi
programme.desc: Un groupe de pirates menés par Kelly, un bandit habillé tout en noir, sème la terreur en s'en prenant aux habitants de Helena et aux bateaux postiers sur le Mississippi. Le shérif James Lively doit aller contre la méfiance des habitants mais aussi des Indiens. Mais avec l'aide des Cherokees, car les bandits se sont établis sur leurs terres, et de son adjoint Tom Quincy, il parvient à mettre fin à leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Texas
programme.desc: A Dallas, un ancien soldat de l'Union tente de démasquer une conspiration de Sudistes qui ont assassiné son père, son ami et le Président.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: Un capitaine de cavalerie a beaucoup de mal à maintenir la paix entre son colonel tyrannique et un chef indien déterminé à se venger.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle - La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: Cocinísima T01
programme.desc: El chef Mariano Sandoval nos lleva de la mano aprendiendo hacer increíbles platillos internacionales con fáciles recetas de cocina.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle - La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.desc: Yoga y tú, nos acercará al fascinante mundo de la meditación a través del yoga.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Sergio Gutiérrez, actor, guionista y director independiente, sobre sus inicios en la actuación, su pasión por los escenarios y el proceso de construir personajes completos. Con una trayectoria que incluye participaciones en series de televisión, streaming y teatro, Sergio comparte anécdotas de sets masivos, entrenamientos con dobles de riesgo y su paso por producciones como míticas. Reflexionamos sobre la importancia de no juzgar a sus propios personajes, la presencia total en escena, y el valor del capital humano en tiempos de inteligencia artificial. Una charla auténtica y dinámica que revela lo que significa vivir la actuación desde todas sus trincheras.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle - La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Rafa Mercadante, conductor, actor y locutor que ha dejado huella en la televisión mexicana y estadounidense. Desde sus inicios soñando con estar frente a las cámaras hasta convertirse en el primer conductor de "Escape Perfecto", nos comparte anécdotas de sus momentos más caóticos, divertidos y emotivos en pantalla. El también cantante y productor nos lleva tras bambalinas de grandes transmisiones como la de "El Desfile de las Rosas", experiencia que lo llevó a ganar un Emmy, y donde revive la exclusiva que tuvo con George Lucas. Un viaje entre historias, aprendizajes y pasiones que muestran a un artista multidisciplinario que ha sabido reinventarse dentro y fuera del set.

programme.title: Blue Helmets, No Borders: Special Edition Ep.1
programme.desc: Centered on two UN peacekeeping missions in Lebanon and South Sudan, this series follows Chinese soldiers as they fulfill their peacekeeping commitments, embodying the message of a "community with a shared vision for the future" and highlighting the contemporary significance of global governance initiatives.

programme.title: Hermit Master Ep.1
programme.desc: This documentary tracks a three-year journey spanning tens of thousands of kilometers. Adopting a rational and scientific perspective, it interprets the origins of traditional Chinese martial arts and reveals the little-known inheritance and secrets of kung fu.

programme.title: The Grand Canal Ep.7
programme.desc: With the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal as longitude and its 3,000-year history as latitude, this series traces the canal's development from multiple angles, tells the life stories of those along its banks, and reveals the unique status of this world cultural heritage.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker's Guide to China – Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: Documents the journey of host He Tianran and National Geographic photographer Ma Chunlin through the Changping and Haizi valleys, culminating in their crowning achievement: the summit of Mount Siguniang in Sichuan Province.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Follow traveling host He Tianran as he explores Xizang's many cultural treasures. programme.title: Reborn on the Plateau - I Was a Serf
programme.desc: Alongside rare historical footage, four former female serfs reveal the stark contrast between their suffering and the lives of Xizang’s elite under the old order. This documentary bears witness to the brutality of serfdom and the profound transformation of Xizang since 1951.
